method.scope: Seven sequential race starts, two warmup passes and five measured passes. The quality matrix advances 240 simulation updates without drawing, then measures 60 moving frames per pass. The baseline measures 120 moving frames after countdown. Timings include GPU completion/bitmap creation when selected, exclude diagnostic hashes, main-thread delivery, audio and scanout. Throughput is computed work rate, not delivered display FPS. Native startup ends after first draw submission (complete on CPU); browser startup includes its first frame and uses the executor byte fallback, without the launcher module cache. Native executor and OS/browser caches are retained. This short rollout does not qualify the complete course or minimum hardware.
